payload.title: Validating PReSto2k
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook aims to validate the PReSto2k reconstructions by comparing them against the LMRv2.1 baseline and instrumental datasets. It loads three PReSto2k reconstructions with different seasonality approaches and compares them to LMRv2.1 using various statistical techniques. The notebook employs visualization and statistical analysis to assess the differences and similarities between reconstructions and validate them against instrumental datasets like GISTEMP, HADCRUT5, and BEST.
goals: Evaluate the skill of PReSto2k reconstructions.
